standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the geometric connectedness of the fibres of the finite type model.

core_obligations: Reduce to affine and then to finite type (proof lines 16699-16703): the statement is local on X, so assume X affine and write it as a cofiltered limit of affine schemes of finite type over S; the colimit base change lemma then reduces to the case where X is of finite type over S.

Apply the general base change lemma (proof lines 16704-16709): over a separably closed field any scheme of finite type is a finite disjoint union of connected and geometrically connected schemes, so the general base change statement applies and gives the assertion.
proof_roadmap: Localise to an affine X and present it as a cofiltered limit of finite type models, invoking the colimit base change lemma.
Use the structure of finite type schemes over a separably closed field to verify the geometric connectedness hypothesis of the general base change lemma.
difficulty_reason: The lemma establishes base change for pushforwards of sheaves of sets when the base is the spectrum of a separably closed field (statement lines 16684-16696). The proof (proof lines 16698-16709) localises to an affine X, reduces to a finite type model through the colimit base change lemma, and then applies the general base change statement, the geometric connectedness being supplied by the structure of finite type schemes over such a field. H2: one reduction plus one application.
